branding.greeting: Hi! I’m the AI assistant for Cedar Hollow Heating & Air, a fictional demo business. I can answer questions about our services and hours, check whether we serve your ZIP code, and take a callback request.

profile.hoursNote: Callback requests sent outside office hours are answered the next business day.

services.name: AC repair
services.description: Diagnosis and repair of central air conditioners.

services.name: Furnace repair
services.description: Diagnosis and repair of gas and electric furnaces.

services.name: Heat pump service
services.description: Repair and seasonal service for heat pumps.

services.name: Seasonal maintenance
services.description: Spring cooling and fall heating tune-ups.

services.name: New system estimate
services.description: In-home visit to discuss replacing a heating or cooling system.

services.name: Thermostat installation
services.description: Installing and setting up programmable and smart thermostats.

faqs.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faqs.answer: Estimates for new heating and cooling systems are free. Repair visits include a diagnostic fee, and the office explains it before booking.

faqs.question: Do you work on all brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our technicians service most major brands of furnaces, air conditioners, and heat pumps.

faqs.question: Are your technicians licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. All Cedar Hollow technicians are licensed and insured.

faqs.question: Do you offer maintenance plans?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Comfort Club plan includes two seasonal tune-ups a year. The office can share details on a callback.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, checks, and major credit cards.

profile.emergencyMessage: If you smell gas, a carbon monoxide alarm is sounding, or you see smoke or fire, leave the building now and call 911 from outside. Then call your gas utility.
